MOVELIMIT.UndoTooltip: Undo last move ({count} available). Shift+click: back to start of turn
MOVELIMIT.SelectTokenToUndo: Select a token to undo its move.
MOVELIMIT.SelectTokenToRedo: Select a token to redo its move.
MOVELIMIT.RedoFailed: Could not redo the move. See the console for details.

gmBypass.name: GM Bypasses Limit
gmBypass.hint: If enabled, drags by a GM are never constrained.

outOfCombat.name: Outside Combat
outOfCombat.hint: How tokens that are not in combat are limited.

offTurn.name: Combatants Off Their Turn
offTurn.hint: How combatants are limited when it is not their turn.
offTurn.turn: Track movement like on their turn

allowExtraMovement.name: Allow Extra Movement
allowExtraMovement.hint: When a token's movement is used up, the next drag starts a new full allotment (Dash, Action Surge, and similar). While any movement remains, drags are limited to exactly that remainder.

maxExtraAllotments.name: Max Extra Allotments per Turn
maxExtraAllotments.hint: 0 = unlimited. Set to 1 to allow a single Dash per turn.

exhaustedThreshold.name: Used-Up Threshold
exhaustedThreshold.hint: Remaining movement at or below this many scene units counts as used up.

measureFallback.name: Measure Zero-Cost Waypoints
measureFallback.hint: If Foundry records a movement step with cost 0, measure its distance instead.

notify.name: Announce Extra Movement
notify.hint: Show a notification when an extra movement allotment is granted.

shiftBypass.name: Shift Releases the Constraint
shiftBypass.hint: Hold Shift while dragging a token to move it without the movement limit. The release lasts until the token is placed, even if Shift is let go before the drop.

showUndoButtons.name: Show Undo/Redo Move Buttons
showUndoButtons.hint: Show the move undo/redo buttons at the bottom of the Combat Tracker.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Log movement budgets and undo steps to the browser console.
